auditor_tom: Hi team — fieldwork request: can you assemble a single-page SOC2 control map + proof pack for the Mar 14 incident that proves: RBAC remediation timeline (who/what/when), KMS promotion with cryptographic linkage (show ciphertexts referencing new version), immutable artifact snapshot with sha256 and a signed manifest, and a short vuln-triage summary. Paste exact S3 paths and copy/paste audit query snippets.

maria: Yep. We'll produce a "proof-pack-v2" folder with everything. Top-level artifacts will be: terraform-diff.txt (redacted), iam-events.json.gz, kms-events.jsonl, manifest.json and manifest.sig (signed by infra), bundle.tar.gz + bundle.tar.gz.sha256, triage.md. All under s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/.

leo: RBAC detail: role binding removed by terraform apply at 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z. Exported plan/apply to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/terraform-diff.txt (account ids redacted). CloudTrail query we used:
```
filter eventName in (DetachRolePolicy, DeleteRolePolicy) and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:00:00Z" and eventTime <= "2025-03-14T09:10:00Z"
```
Matches exported to iam-events.json.gz (event ids preserved).

infra-bot: auto-export: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/iam-events.json.gz (sha256: 7b3c2a9d...), s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/terraform-diff.txt (sha256: c1d2e3f4...), and s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/manifest.json.sig (signed-by: infra@redwood.com).

maria: KMS: alias/serving-cmk promoted to version 14 at 2025-03-14T09:12:03Z. CloudTrail Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries include requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId ending with ":14" for post-promotion writes. We also preserved x-amz-meta-kms-version:14 as object metadata on uploads after promotion. Export path: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/kms-events.jsonl. Short CloudTrail snippet (copy/paste):
```
{ eventTime: "2025-03-14T09:12:05Z", eventName: "Encrypt", requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/beat-0000-1111-2222:14" } }
```

evidence-bot: bundle archived to s3://redwood-worm/6311112222/bundle.tar.gz with Object Lock (Governance) retention-until: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z; adjacent checksum file s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/bundle.tar.gz.sha256 (ascii). manifest.json lists filenames+sha256 and manifest.json.sig is an ASCII GPG signature signed by infra GPG key (fingerprint: AB12 CD34 EF56 7890 1234 5678 9ABC DEF0 1234, key id 0xDEF01234).

leo: Vulnerability triage: INC-6311112222/triage.md attached in the pack. Short summary: CVE-2025-9001 in base image redwood/serving:3.0; severity=high; mitigation was rebuild image v3.0.1 and rolling restart completed 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z. Deploy logs exported to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/deploy-log.txt.gz.

auditor_tom: Two quick asks: 1) paste one redacted terraform diff line with the apply timestamp I can copy into the binder, 2) paste the minimal CloudTrail Encrypt event (redacted) that references :14 so we can show cryptographic linkage.

maria: Terraform snippet (redacted, copyable):
```
- resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "svc_readonly" {
-   role       = "svc-pod-readonly"
-   policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
- }
apply timestamp: 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z
```
CloudTrail sample (redacted, copyable):
```
{ eventTime: "2025-03-14T09:12:05Z", eventName: "Encrypt", requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/beat-0000-1111-2222:14" } }
```

infra-bot: Presigned GETs (48h): manifest: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/manifest.json.sig?token=EXAMPLE ; bundle: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-worm/6311112222/bundle.tar.gz?token=EXAMPLE. Please verify before the links expire.

auditor_tom: Great. Please post the one-page control map (plain text) with fields: Control ID, Incident ID, Summary, Evidence list (paths+hashes), Audit queries (copy/paste), Retention/WORM details, Crypto assertions (GPG fingerprint + KMS key ARN+version), Redactions, Owner. I'll drop into the SOC2 binder.

maria: Control map (plain text):
Control ID: SEC-INC-2025-03-14-PP | Incident ID: INC-6311112222
Summary: RBAC role-binding removal and key promotion after suspected pod compromise. CMK alias/serving-cmk promoted to version 14; artifacts re-encrypted and archived to WORM.
Evidence (paths + hashes):
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/terraform-diff.txt (sha256: c1d2e3f4...) — exported plan/apply showing RBAC removal; apply timestamp 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z.
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/iam-events.json.gz (sha256: 7b3c2a9d...) — CloudTrail IAM events matching the apply.
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/kms-events.jsonl (sha256: 8f9e0a1b...) — CloudTrail Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries showing destinationKeyVersionId ending in :14.
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/manifest.json.sig (sha256: 5f6e7d8c...) — GPG-signed manifest (infra GPG fingerprint AB12 CD34 EF56 7890 1234 5678 9ABC DEF0 1234, key id 0xDEF01234).
- s3://redwood-worm/6311112222/bundle.tar.gz (retention-until: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z) and s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/bundle.tar.gz.sha256 (ASCII checksum).
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/triage.md and s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6311112222/deploy-log.txt.gz (vuln triage and remediation; fix applied 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z).
Audit queries (copy/paste):
- IAM/CloudTrail: filter eventName in (DetachRolePolicy, DeleteRolePolicy) and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:00:00Z" and eventTime <= "2025-03-14T09:10:00Z"
- KMS/CloudTrail: filter eventName in (Encrypt, ReEncrypt) and requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId endswith ":14" and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:12:00Z"
Verification steps: 1) gpg --keyserver keys.redwood.com --recv-keys 0xDEF01234; gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json; 2) sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | compare to bundle.tar.gz.sha256; 3) grep -F ":14" kms-events.jsonl to find Encrypt/ReEncrypt events referencing version 14; 4) match terraform-diff.txt apply timestamp to iam-events.json.gz entries.
Retention/WORM: bundle.tar.gz copied to redwood-worm bucket with Object Lock (Governance mode), retention set 365 days (retention-until: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z).
Crypto assertions: infra GPG fingerprint AB12 CD34 EF56 7890 1234 5678 9ABC DEF0 1234 (key id 0xDEF01234); KMS key ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/beat-0000-1111-2222, promoted version 14 referenced in ciphertexts.
Redactions: terraform-diff.txt and audit exports redacted for account ids and PII per evidence-redaction policy.
Owner: Security Engineering (maria@redwood.com, leo@redwood.com). Contact: security-oncall@redwood.com.

auditor_tom: Thanks — this is exactly what I need. I'll add to the binder and run the verification steps. Leaving thread open for 48h for any follow-ups.
